'''Darth Nostrem''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]] who lived several [[Time/Legends|decades]] before the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] initiated the conflict known as the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. During Nostrem's lifetime, [[Darth/Legends|Darths]] [[Darth Qalar|Qalar]] and [[Darth Victun|Victun]], two members of the ruling [[Dark Council]], were embroiled in a [[Kaggath (c. 4043 BBY)|particularly violent]] [[Kaggath]]&mdash;a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition that pitted two rivals against each other in battle.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

The duel destroyed the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and Nostrem was tasked with rebuilding the Citadel by the Council. Nostrem was ordered to utilize the resources of Qalar and Victun, who had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the rest of the Council, to rebuild the Citadel according to the designs of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. After the structure was completed, the Emperor locked Nostrem in the depths of Citadel to test its labyrinthine defenses, and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] eventually died after he failed to escape.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Nostrem was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2012]] reference guide for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
